name: 水暖循环恒温电热毯款
description: 水循环均匀暖床、多档恒温调节、左右分区独立控温

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep pine-green backdrop #175A4F for hero and closing shots, alternating with warm cream panels #F7F3EA and pure white #FFFFFF for infographic and trust shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused warm studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm sand-orange podium ledge #F6B14B, light-wood nightstand #E8DCC8, light grey matte board #D9D9D6
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2D2D2D on light grounds and warm cream #F7F3EA on dark grounds, with thin-line labels for feature annotations
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in the single warm sand-orange accent #F6B14B, consistent rounded info cards
styleLock.presentationRules: control unit and blanket always presented as one system, stable hero 3/4 angle and scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine-green backdrop #175A4F, warm cream panel #F7F3EA, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm sand-orange accent #F6B14B; soft diffused warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2D2D2D on light grounds and warm cream #F7F3EA on dark grounds; consistent rounded info cards and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the control unit and blanket always presented as one system at a stable hero angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 低角度气场开场，一眼记住主机质感并赢取点击
shots.camera: slightly low angle looking upward at a 15-30 degree 3/4 view, full product visible
shots.lighting: soft diffused warm studio key from the front left, soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep pine-green wall #175A4F meeting a warm sand-orange podium ledge #F6B14B
shots.textZone: top-left one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in warm cream #F7F3EA
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The control unit standing on a warm sand-orange podium ledge #F6B14B against a deep pine-green wall #175A4F, photographed from a slightly low angle looking upward at a 3/4 view, full product visible and filling 60-70% of the frame. Soft diffused warm studio light from the front left with gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. One short headline 「{callout_1}」 in warm cream #F7F3EA sits at the top left, completing one balanced composition. 8K, commercial appliance e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand text, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no garbled display digits, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大冬夜冰凉被窝的痛点，再给出暖床解法

shots.lighting: left panel dim cool light; right panel soft warm light, identical direction both sides
shots.background: left panel cool slate bedroom tone #33414F; right panel warm cream #F7F3EA
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing and identical light direction. Left panel: an empty neatly made bed on a cold winter night rendered in a cool slate tone #33414F with dim light, conveying an icy uninviting bed. Right panel: {product} laid on the bed under soft warm light on a warm cream backdrop #F7F3EA, conveying cozy warmth. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bed fills 50-60% of each panel so both sides read as full compositions. One short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D near the top of each panel. Negative: no model face, no shivering person, no fabricated statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched perspective between panels.

shots.intent: 微距展示主机显示与旋钮做工，证明操控精准

shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing surface finish and crisp display
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the digital display and rotary dial of the control unit. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 30-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the matte surface finish and a crisp clean display. Keep the display reading as clean simple numeric digits with no invented values. Negative: no blurry subject, no garbled display digits, no fake UI icons, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no fingerprints, no smudges.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张爆款水暖电热毯详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌名、英文装饰词、认证机构与承保信息、二维码水印及全部原文案，产品一律以 {product} 占位；信任镜改为以走线、水管等可验证做工细节呈现，档位温度等数值不发明、由 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写。
